note: Generated by kit/blocks/build.py from design/app-blocks (the designer’s App Blocks); do not edit. Keywords come from kit/blocks/keywords.json. Paths are relative to the harness folder.

basecoat.what: the styles every app block uses (vega style)

basecoat-js.what: Basecoat’s script for its interactive parts (menus, popovers, tabs, selects, toasts, the sidebar)

basecoat-chart.what: Basecoat’s chart wrapper, basecoat.chart(); load after Chart.js and Basecoat’s script

littlejs.what: the game engine, as gaming-core scaffolds it (tools/game.py init)

cards.name: About
cards.purpose: What this app is, its version, who made it, and the licences of what it is built with: one quiet page reached from Settings.

cards.name: AccountSettings
cards.purpose: The account's own settings: change the email, change the password, see and end sessions on other devices, and the way to delete the account.

cards.name: ActivityFeed
cards.purpose: What everyone did in a project, newest first and grouped by day: who did what to which thing, with a filter by person or kind.

cards.name: Agenda
cards.purpose: A month calendar beside the list of events for the chosen day, with a way to add an event; on the phone the list comes first under a strip of days.

cards.name: AppAdmin
cards.purpose: An admin dashboard for running an app: an overview of the numbers, then users, orders, reports and settings, each a list that opens a detail.

cards.name: AppBoard
cards.purpose: A kanban project board: boards with columns, cards that move across them, card details with checklists, labels, due dates and comments, shared with a team.

ja: プロジェクト管理アプリ

cards.name: AppBooking
cards.purpose: A booking app: people pick a service, a person and a free time, book and get a confirmation; the business sees its calendar and manages hours and bookings.

cards.name: AppChat
cards.purpose: A team chat: workspaces with channels and direct messages, threads under messages, reactions, mentions, presence and typing, searchable history.

cards.name: AppCode
cards.purpose: Code collaboration: repositories with their files and history, issues to track work, and reviews of proposed changes with comments on lines.

cards.name: AppCourse
cards.purpose: A course or learning app: courses made of lessons (video or text), quizzes, progress that is kept, and a certificate or a streak at the end.

cards.name: AppCrm
cards.purpose: A CRM: contacts and companies, deals moving through a pipeline, the history of every call and email, and the follow-up tasks that keep deals moving.

cards.name: AppForum
cards.purpose: A forum or community: categories of topics, replies with reactions and mentions, profiles, notifications, and the moderation tools that keep it kind.

cards.name: AppFoundations
cards.purpose: The rules every block assumes: the app root, one breakpoint, phone targets, dark mode, the two languages, chart colours and the Basecoat details that trip a small model.

cards.name: AppNotes
cards.purpose: A notes and wiki app: pages made of blocks, nested in a page tree, shared with people who can view or edit, searchable from anywhere.

cards.name: AppPortfolio
cards.purpose: A personal site: a short introduction, selected work with case studies, a blog, and a way to get in touch.

cards.name: AppShop
cards.purpose: An online shop with its storefront (browse, product page, cart, checkout, orders) and the admin the owner runs it from (products, orders, stock, coupons, sales).

cards.name: AreaChart
cards.purpose: An area chart for totals over time that add up (by device, by plan), stacked so the top edge is the total.

cards.name: ArtFrames
cards.purpose: How UI frames, buttons and icons look in the pixel style and in the vector (SVG) style, so menus match the world they sit on.

cards.name: ArtPalettes
cards.purpose: The named palettes every generated sprite, tile, icon and game UI draws from, so a whole game agrees on its colours.

cards.name: ArtReferenceSet
cards.purpose: The target set the generators aim at: a hero, a monster, an item, a tile, an icon and a button, each in the pixel style and in the vector style.

cards.name: ArtSprites
cards.purpose: How generated sprites are built: the size grid, outlines, shading from one light, animation frames and characters made of named parts.

cards.name: ArticleBody
cards.purpose: The read-only body of an article or blog post: title and meta with reading time, headings, images with captions, quotes, code and footnotes, styled with plain utilities.

cards.name: AvatarGroup
cards.purpose: A person's picture or initials, alone or as an overlapping group with a “+N” count, for owners, members and who is here.

cards.name: BarChart
cards.purpose: A bar chart to compare amounts across categories or days, grouped side by side or stacked into a total.

cards.name: BlockEditor
cards.purpose: A page made of blocks (paragraphs, headings, lists, to-dos, quotes, code, dividers, images), each with a handle to move or change it and a slash menu to add a new one.

cards.name: BottomBar
cards.purpose: The phone's main navigation: up to five places along the bottom edge, in reach of the thumb.

cards.name: Breadcrumbs
cards.purpose: Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy and links to each level above it; on the phone, one Back link to the parent.

cards.name: CardHand
cards.purpose: A hand of cards along the bottom, the deck and discard piles, card detail on focus, and the deck list for building.

cards.name: Cart
cards.purpose: The cart: each item with its picture, variant, quantity and line price, a Remove with Undo, and the order summary with shipping, tax and Check Out.

cards.name: Channels
cards.purpose: The chat itself: a list of channels and direct messages with unread marks, the open conversation with day separators, who is typing, and the message box.

ja: ダイレクトメッセージ

cards.name: Checkout
cards.purpose: Checkout in four steps (address, delivery, payment, review) with the order summary beside it, Japanese address fields, and payment by card, convenience store or bank transfer.

cards.name: CodeDiff
cards.purpose: A file viewer for code with line numbers, and the same viewer showing a change: removed lines, added lines, unchanged context folded, unified or side by side.

cards.name: CodeView
cards.purpose: One file shown read-only with line numbers, wrap on or off, copy, and a link to any line, for code collaboration apps.

cards.name: ComboboxField
cards.purpose: Choose from a list too long or too rich for a native select: a rich select (a button that opens a list) or a combobox (type to filter), one value or several.

cards.name: CommandPalette
cards.purpose: One search box for everything: go to a place, find a note, or run an action, opened with ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl K anywhere.

cards.name: Comments
cards.purpose: A comment thread under a page, post or item: who said what and when, one level of replies, and a box to write a new comment.

cards.name: ConfirmDialog
cards.purpose: Ask before an action that can't be undone or that affects other people: a title that is the question, what will happen, and two buttons named by their actions.

cards.name: ControlsRemap
cards.purpose: Shows every action with its key, mouse button and gamepad button, and lets the person change one by pressing the new input; prompts follow the device in use.

cards.name: Coupons
cards.purpose: The coupon code field in the cart with its applied and error states, and the shop’s single rulebook for price and stock states (sale, low stock, sold out, pre-order, price changed).

cards.name: CsvImport
cards.purpose: Bring records in from a CSV file in four steps: choose the file, match its columns to the app's fields, check a preview that marks bad rows, then import with progress and a report.

cards.name: Dashboard
cards.purpose: A summary page: four stat tiles with their change since the last period, one chart of the trend, and a short list of what needs attention.

cards.name: DataTable
cards.purpose: A table of many similar records with sortable columns, row selection, a row action and pages of 20.

cards.name: DatabaseView
cards.purpose: A database of pages shown as a table, a board or a list, with view tabs, filters, sort and properties, like a Notion database.

cards.name: DatePicker
cards.purpose: Pick one date with a calendar popover that reads the page's language (2026年10月14日 in Japanese), or the browser's own date field on an English-only internal page.

cards.name: DeleteAccount
cards.purpose: Delete the account for good: say plainly what happens to the data, offer a copy first, confirm with the password, and allow cancelling for 30 days.

cards.name: DeleteUndo
cards.purpose: Deleting without asking first: the thing disappears at once and a toast offers Undo for 8 seconds; it really goes to a Trash kept 30 days.

cards.name: DetailView
cards.purpose: One record on its own page: its title, its few facts, its content and the actions on it (Edit, Share, More).

cards.name: DialogueBox
cards.purpose: A character speaks at the bottom of the screen with a portrait, the text appearing letter by letter, and up to four choices.

cards.name: DocEditor
cards.purpose: A note or document editor: a title, a small formatting toolbar, the body, and a line that says whether the changes are saved.

ja: ドキュメントエディタ
マークダウンエディタ

cards.name: DonutChart
cards.purpose: A donut (or pie) for the parts of one whole, at most five parts, with the total in the middle and the percentages in a table.

cards.name: DragList
cards.purpose: Reorder a list by dragging a handle, with Move Up and Move Down for keyboards and anyone who can't drag.

cards.name: EditForm
cards.purpose: The form that creates a record or edits one: labelled fields, help under them, errors that say how to fix them, and one Save button.

cards.name: EmailConfirm
cards.purpose: Confirm a new account's email: the page that waits for the link, and the page the link opens.

cards.name: EmptyState
cards.purpose: What a list, page or panel shows when it has nothing in it: why it's empty and the one thing to do next.

cards.name: Equipment
cards.purpose: What the character wears and holds: one slot per body place, the stats they add, and a comparison before changing anything.

cards.name: ErrorRetry
cards.purpose: What shows when something fails: what happened in plain words, that nothing was lost, and a Try Again button, in the place the content would have been.

cards.name: ExportCsv
cards.purpose: Export the rows of a list as a CSV file: choose columns and rows, a file name, a Japanese-safe option for Excel, with progress for large exports.

cards.name: FileTree
cards.purpose: A folder tree people open, close and choose files in: a project's files, a page tree's folders, an archive.

cards.name: FileUpload
cards.purpose: A drop zone and file button that uploads one or more files, shows each with a preview, its progress and a way to remove it.

cards.name: Flashcards
cards.purpose: A deck studied one card at a time: see the front, flip to the back, then say whether you knew it, so cards you miss come back sooner.

cards.name: ForgotPassword
cards.purpose: Reset a forgotten password in two steps: ask for the email, then set a new password from the link in that email.

cards.name: FunnelChart
cards.purpose: A funnel for the steps people go through (visit, view, add to cart, pay), drawn as horizontal bars, with how many carried on at each step.

cards.name: Gallery
cards.purpose: A grid of images that opens each one large in a viewer, with previous/next, its caption and a way to download or delete it.

cards.name: GameArcade
cards.purpose: Arcade classics on one shell — a paddle game, a brick breaker and a snake game: instant start, lives, a rising score and a high-score table.

cards.name: GameCards
cards.purpose: A trading card game: build a deck from a collection, then play turns of draw, spend energy, play cards to the board and attack until a player’s health is gone.

ja: トレーディングカードゲーム

cards.name: GameCozy
cards.purpose: A cozy farming and life game: plant, water and harvest through a day cycle, craft, sell at the shop and befriend the villagers.

cards.name: GameIdle
cards.purpose: An idle or clicker game: tap to earn, buy upgrades that earn on their own, come back later to collect what was made while away.

cards.name: GameKit
cards.purpose: The game layer: HTML menus, HUD and prompts over a gaming-core (LittleJS) canvas, with the input device in use deciding every prompt.

cards.name: GameOver
cards.purpose: When the player is out of lives or health: what happened, what was kept, and Try Again from the last checkpoint as the first choice.

cards.name: GamePlatformer
cards.purpose: A side-scrolling platformer: run and jump through levels, collect coins, avoid or stomp enemies and reach the flag.

cards.name: GamePuzzle
cards.purpose: Puzzle games on a grid — match-3, sliding tiles and Sokoban — sharing one shell: levels, moves or time, stars and undo.

cards.name: GameRacing
cards.purpose: A top-down racing game: laps around a track against rivals or the clock, with a start countdown, positions and a results table.

cards.name: GameRoguelike
cards.purpose: A roguelike or roguelite: descend procedural floors, fight, find items, lose everything on death and carry unlocks into the next run.

cards.name: GameRpg
cards.purpose: A top-down role-playing game: explore a map, talk to people, fight, collect items and finish quests.

cards.name: GameSettings
cards.purpose: The game's own settings, in three tabs: Audio, Language and Display; every change applies at once and is saved.

cards.name: GameShooter
cards.purpose: A vertical shoot ’em up: fly through waves of enemies, pick up power-ups, beat the boss, chase the high score.

cards.name: GameTactics
cards.purpose: A grid tactics game: turn-based battles on a square grid where each unit moves, attacks or uses a skill, with the outcome forecast before acting.

cards.name: GameTowerDefence
cards.purpose: A tower defence game: enemies walk a path in waves; place and upgrade towers beside it so none reach the end.

cards.name: GameVisualNovel
cards.purpose: A visual novel: a story told in scenes of backgrounds, characters and lines of dialogue, with choices that branch it, saves, and a log of what was said.

cards.name: GaugeRing
cards.purpose: A gauge or progress ring for one value against a limit or goal (storage used, lessons done), with the value written in the middle.

cards.name: GlobalSearch
cards.purpose: One search across everything in the app (pages, messages, issues, files, people), results grouped by kind with the matched words marked, and filters to narrow to one kind.

cards.name: HeatmapCalendar
cards.purpose: A calendar grid of small squares, one per day, shaded by how much happened that day (lessons, commits, orders), with a weekly table.

cards.name: Help
cards.purpose: Answers to the questions people actually ask, searchable, in short sections, with the keyboard shortcuts and a way to reach a person when the answer isn't there.

cards.name: HudPieces
cards.purpose: The pieces a game shows during play, each in a fixed corner: health, energy, score, timer, minimap, objective and combo.

cards.name: InfiniteScroll
cards.purpose: Load the next page of a long list when the person reaches the end, with a Load More button that always works as the fallback.

cards.name: InlineAlert
cards.purpose: A message that stays in the page next to what it is about: information, a warning, or an error that blocks the task, with at most one action.

cards.name: InstallApp
cards.purpose: Offer to install the app on the phone's home screen: one button where the browser can install it, two short steps where it can't (Safari on iPhone), and silence once it's installed or declined.

ja: アプリのインストール

cards.name: InventoryGrid
cards.purpose: The items the player carries, as a grid of slots with counts, a detail panel for the selected item, and Use, Drop and Sort.

cards.name: Invite
cards.purpose: A dialog to invite people to a project or workspace by email, choosing each one's role, plus a link that anyone can join with; the person invited gets an accept page.

cards.name: IssueDetail
cards.purpose: One issue: its title and state, the description, the conversation and events in time order, a reply box with Close Issue, and a side column for assignees, labels and links.

cards.name: IssueList
cards.purpose: The list of issues (or tasks, tickets, requests): open and closed tabs, search and filters by label, assignee and author, sorting, and one row per issue with its labels and counts.

cards.name: Kanban
cards.purpose: A board of columns (To Do, Doing, Done) holding cards that the person drags between columns, or moves with a menu and the keyboard.

cards.name: KpiTile
cards.purpose: A tile with one key number, its change from the last period in words and an arrow, an optional sparkline, and a link to the full report.

cards.name: LabelsAssignees
cards.purpose: Pickers that set the labels and the people on an item (an issue, a card, a ticket): a searchable checklist in a popover, the chosen ones shown as badges and avatars, and a page to manage the labels themselves.

cards.name: LevelSelect
cards.purpose: A grid of levels grouped by world, each showing locked, open or finished with its stars and best time, and Play.

cards.name: LineChart
cards.purpose: A line chart for a value over time, one to five series, with its legend, tooltip and a table of the same numbers.

cards.name: ListSearch
cards.purpose: A list of the person's things with a search field and a few filters above it; results update as they type.

cards.name: LoadingState
cards.purpose: What shows while something loads: nothing for the first 300 ms, then grey skeletons shaped like the content, and a plain sentence if it takes over 8 seconds.

cards.name: LogIn
cards.purpose: Log in with an email and a password, with the ways to sign up and to reset a forgotten password.

cards.name: LogOut
cards.purpose: Log out from the account menu, then land on a page that says so and offers to log in again.

cards.name: MapPlaceholder
cards.purpose: Show where a place is without a map library: the address, how to get there, and a link that opens the person's own maps app.

cards.name: MapScreen
cards.purpose: The full map of the world or the current area: where the player is, places found, the tracked quest, a legend, and travel to places already visited.

cards.name: Mentions
cards.purpose: Typing @ in a message, comment or page opens a list of people (and pages with [[) to mention; the mention becomes a chip and notifies the person.

cards.name: MessageComposer
cards.purpose: The chat composer: a growing message field with mentions, emoji, files, Send and Schedule for Later, and the same form for editing a message.

cards.name: Notifications
cards.purpose: The list of things that happened for this person (replies, mentions, invitations, reminders), newest first, with unread ones marked and a way to mark them read.

cards.name: OfflineBanner
cards.purpose: A thin band at the top of the app while the device is offline: what still works, how many changes wait to sync, and a short "Back online" when the connection returns.

cards.name: Onboarding
cards.purpose: The first time the app opens: choose the language, see in one sentence each what the app does, and start with one real action. Three steps, skippable, never shown again.

cards.name: OrderConfirmation
cards.purpose: The page after a successful order: thanks with the order number, where the receipt went, what happens next, and for convenience-store or bank payments the payment number and deadline.

cards.name: OrderHistory
cards.purpose: The person’s past orders, newest first, with number, date, status, item count and total: a table on the desktop and a list on the phone.

cards.name: PageTree
cards.purpose: The nested list of pages in a workspace, in the side panel: open and close branches, add a page inside another, rename, move and favourite.

cards.name: PauseMenu
cards.purpose: Stops the world and offers Resume, Settings, Controls and Quit to Title; opens on Esc, the start button, the pause button on touch, or when the window loses focus.

cards.name: Presence
cards.purpose: Who else is here right now, live: the avatars of people on the same page, what they are looking at or typing, and the connection state, for multiplayer apps.

cards.name: ProductGrid
cards.purpose: A grid of product cards with picture, name, price and an Add to Cart button, showing sale, low-stock and sold-out states, with a count and a sort control.

cards.name: ProductPage
cards.purpose: One product: a picture gallery, the price with sale and stock, variant choices (size, colour), quantity, Add to Cart, and details in an accordion.

cards.name: Profile
cards.purpose: The person's public face in the app: a picture, a display name and a short bio, with the picture uploaded or removed.

cards.name: ProgressStatus
cards.purpose: Show that something takes time and how far it is: a bar when the amount is known, a spinner with a sentence when it isn't, and a way to cancel long work.

cards.name: PullReview
cards.purpose: Reviewing a proposed change: the files it touches, comments on lines, and finishing the review with Approve, Request Changes or Comment, plus merging when the checks pass.

cards.name: QuestLog
cards.purpose: The player's quests: active, done and failed, each with its giver, steps checked off, the reward, and the option to track one on the HUD.

cards.name: QuizQuestion
cards.purpose: One quiz question at a time, single choice, multiple choice or a short typed answer, with Check, the explanation, and the running score.

cards.name: Reactions
cards.purpose: A row of small emoji counters under a message or comment, plus a button to add one; pressing a counter adds or removes your reaction.

cards.name: ReportContent
cards.purpose: A dialog to report a post or comment to the moderators: pick a reason, add details if needed, send, and see that it was received.

cards.name: ResultsScores
cards.purpose: After a level or a run: the score counted up line by line, stars or rank, a new best marked, and the high-score table with name entry.

cards.name: Reviews
cards.purpose: Star ratings and written reviews for a product: the summary, the list with helpful votes and the shop’s replies, and the form to write one.

cards.name: Roles
cards.purpose: The members page of a project or workspace: each person with their role (Owner, Member, Viewer), a way for owners to change a role or remove someone, and a table of what each role can do.

cards.name: RunStatus
cards.purpose: The status of an automated check run for a commit or pull request: queued, running, passed or failed, its steps, the failing log lines and re-run.

cards.name: SaveSlots
cards.purpose: Three save slots for saving and loading, each showing the place, play time and when it was saved, with overwrite and delete confirmed first.

cards.name: SavedState
cards.purpose: A quiet line that says whether the person's work is saved: "Saving…", "Saved at 14:32", "Not saved" with Try Again, next to the thing being edited.

cards.name: ScatterChart
cards.purpose: A scatter chart to show how two numbers go together (hours and scores, price and sales), one point per item, groups told apart by colour and point shape.

cards.name: SettingsPage
cards.purpose: The app's settings in one page, language first: each change applies and saves at once, grouped under plain headings, with the account and the app's information at the end.

cards.name: ShippingRates
cards.purpose: Delivery prices by area and speed, the free-delivery threshold, and the delivery line shown in the cart and at checkout.

cards.name: ShopScreen
cards.purpose: Buy and sell with a shopkeeper: a list of goods with prices, what you own of each, your coins, and a quantity step before paying.

cards.name: ShortcutHelp
cards.purpose: A dialog listing the app's keyboard shortcuts by group, opened with ? or from Help, so shortcuts can be learned instead of guessed.

ja: キーボードショートカット

cards.name: SidePanel
cards.purpose: The app's main navigation on the left: sections, collapsible groups and count badges, hidden on the phone until opened.

cards.name: SignUp
cards.purpose: Create an account with a name, an email and a password, then confirm the email.

cards.name: Skeletons
cards.purpose: Grey shapes in the layout of the content that is loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives.

cards.name: Sparkline
cards.purpose: A word-sized line with no axes, beside a number, to show its recent direction at a glance; the number and the table carry the values.

cards.name: StatusBadges
cards.purpose: Short labels that say what state a thing is in (Paid, Draft, Overdue, In stock), with a fixed set of meanings so every app reads the same.

cards.name: Stepper
cards.purpose: Show where the person is in a task of a few ordered steps (checkout, sign-up, setup) and let them go back to a finished step.

cards.name: Tabs
cards.purpose: Switches between a few views of the same thing (a note, an order, a person) without leaving the page.

cards.name: TagInput
cards.purpose: Type free words and turn each into a removable tag, with suggestions from tags already used.

cards.name: Threads
cards.purpose: Replies to one message, opened beside the conversation: the first message on top, its replies in order, and a reply box, with the option to also send the reply to the channel.

cards.name: TimePicker
cards.purpose: Pick a time of day: a list of times that reads right in both languages, free slots when only some times can be booked, and the browser's own time field only on English-only pages.

cards.name: Timeline
cards.purpose: A dated list of events in order, newest first or oldest first: an order's history, a ticket's changes, a course's milestones.

cards.name: TitleScreen
cards.purpose: The first screen of a game: its name over the world, Continue or New Game, and the way to settings and quitting.

cards.name: Toasts
cards.purpose: Short messages that confirm something just happened, bottom right on the desktop and bottom centre on the phone, gone after a few seconds.

cards.name: TopBar
cards.purpose: The bar across the top of every page: the side panel toggle, search, the main "New" action, notifications and the account menu.

cards.name: TouchControls
cards.purpose: On-screen controls for phones: a movement stick under the left thumb and one to three action buttons under the right, shown only when touch is the device in use.

cards.name: TutorialPrompt
cards.purpose: A short hint at the moment it's needed, naming the action with the prompt of the device in use: “Press [Space] to jump”.

cards.name: UpdateAvailable
cards.purpose: Tell the person a new version of the app is ready, and let them reload when it suits them: a toast that stays until they choose, never a forced reload.

cards.name: WeekCalendar
cards.purpose: A week of days side by side with hour rows, the events placed by time, a line for now, and new events made by clicking or dragging an empty slot (or from the keyboard).

cards.name: WipLimit
cards.purpose: A work-in-progress limit on a Kanban column: the count against the limit in the column header, a warning when the column goes over, and a small form to set or remove the limit.
